scientific_rationale.one_step_horizon: A declared graph edge is the elemental transition admitted by a structural world. One-step support therefore measures local transition opportunity without collapsing the graph to connected-component closure.
scientific_rationale.cutoff: The 0.5 majority criterion is carried unchanged from v1 and is not retuned to the response-blind NEON forecast distribution or any biological outcome.
scientific_rationale.deduplication: Two labels with exactly the same admitted-edge adjacency encode one structural hypothesis and must receive one denominator weight.

world_construction.canonical_duplicate_id_rule: lexicographically smallest world ID within each exact adjacency group

response_compatibility.world_survives_if: every ever-positive target has positive one-step support from at least one other ever-positive peer under the canonical distinct world

change the 0.5 cutoff after biological response access
